nodes.name: SignedDifferenceSquare
nodes.summary: The natural value s of the integer square (p−n)², expressed as a subtraction-free balanced equality.

nodes.name: GaussianSignedNorm
nodes.summary: The actual sum (ap−an)²+(bp−bn)² of two witnessed signed-coordinate squares.

nodes.name: GNorm
nodes.summary: The actual norm a²+b² of the shared canonical pair code representing the Gaussian integer a+bi.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: GProperNormDivisor
nodes.summary: d is an actual nonunit divisor of z and has a witnessed actual Gaussian norm strictly below N. This is not a supplied factorization oracle.

nodes.name: GStrictNonunitFactorization
nodes.summary: An actual Gaussian product a*b=z, two actual factor norms A,B, nonunit factors, and both strict norm bounds below N. Its existence is a proved search outcome.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: GProductStep
nodes.summary: At index i, decode the factor and the adjacent cumulative values from actual beta codes, then multiply using the actual Gaussian graph.

nodes.name: GProductSteps
nodes.summary: Every index i<l has an actual Gaussian multiplication step in the same beta-coded cumulative history.

nodes.name: GProduct
nodes.summary: A real beta multiplication history begins at Gaussian identity code 6, performs the stated l factor steps, and ends at P. No prime or uniqueness conclusion is included.

nodes.name: GAllIrreducible
nodes.summary: Every actual decoded entry of the finite beta prefix is a Gaussian irreducible; repeated or associated factors remain distinct occurrences.

nodes.name: GAllPrime
nodes.summary: Every actual decoded entry of the finite prefix satisfies the full Gaussian prime-divisor graph.

nodes.name: GIrreducibleFactorization
nodes.summary: The actual unit u times an actual beta product of l irreducible Gaussian entries equals z. It does not assume sorted order, existence or uniqueness.

nodes.name: GPrimeFactorization
nodes.summary: An actual unit and actual finite RingPrime Gaussian factor list reconstruct z through a genuine multiplication trace. Zero is excluded by theorem, not a hidden extra premise here.

nodes.name: GFactorAssociateMatching
nodes.summary: Every actual decoded source factor and its decoded image factor are related by an actual multiplicative unit witness. This graph alone does not assert that the map is bijective.

nodes.name: BoundedPrefix
nodes.summary: Every decoded entry below l is itself below l.

nodes.name: InjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Equal decoded values below l have equal indices.

nodes.name: SurjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Every value below l occurs at an index below l.

nodes.name: PermutationPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual beta-coded bijection of the finite index interval [0,l), including all bounds, injectivity, and surjectivity.

nodes.name: GMatchedFactors
nodes.summary: An actual bounded, injective, surjective beta index map matches all source and target factor occurrences by witnessed Gaussian units.

nodes.name: GFactorPermutation
nodes.summary: The two actual lengths are equal and the given beta map is a genuine unit-matching finite permutation. No identical factor-code or leading-unit claim is made.
